input.summary: Please add CSV export to the reports page
input.description: We paste the table into a spreadsheet by hand every Monday. A CSV button would save us an hour a week. This is really urgent for us.

rubric.criteria: Does not inherit the reporter's urgency for something that does not exist yet.

levels.5: feature, at most `high`, and the reason says the worst case is that a thing which does not exist continues not to exist — without being dismissive of a real weekly cost.
levels.3: feature at a sane priority, but the reason merely restates the request.
levels.1: Marks it urgent because the reporter did, or classifies it as a bug.
